scripts.dev: concurrently -n bot,api,dashboard -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm --filter @aeris/bot dev" "pnpm --filter @aeris/api dev" "VITE_PORT=${PORT:-5173} pnpm --filter @aeris/dashboard dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @aeris/shared build && concurrently -n bot,api,dashboard "pnpm --filter @aeris/bot build" "pnpm --filter @aeris/api build" "pnpm --filter @aeris/dashboard build" && pnpm build:root
